## Accessibility Issue: Focus indicator does not meet AAA Focus Appearance criteria on pricing page

**Bug ID:** `A11Y-7c2a9f3b` (instance) / `A11Y-e8d4b1a5` (pattern)  
**URL:** https://staging.example.dev/pricing  
**XPath:** `//button[@class="select-plan"][contains(@id, "tier")]`  
**Full DOM path:** `/html/body/main/section[@id="plans"]/div[contains(@class,"tier")]/button[contains(@class,"select-plan")]`  
**WCAG SC:** 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (Level AAA)  
**Rule:** keyboard-a11y-tester — focus-appearance-weak-desktop  
**Severity:** Low  
**Frequency:** 4 instances on this page; appears across all pricing tier buttons and billing toggle  
**Screen type:** desktop | **Colour mode:** light

### HTML Snippet

```html
<!-- Example failing element -->
<button class="select-plan" id="tier-1-select">Select Plan</button>
<!-- Other affected elements: -->
<!-- #plans > div.tier:nth-of-type(2) > button.select-plan -->
<!-- #billing-toggle > button.annual -->
```

### Description

The focus indicators on interactive elements in the pricing section (plan selection buttons and billing toggle) are visible but do not meet the AAA Focus Appearance criteria. Specifically, they fail to provide both a minimum 2px perimeter area around the focused element AND a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against their background. This makes it difficult for low-vision users who rely on keyboard navigation to track focus across pricing tiers and options.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Navigate to https://staging.example.dev/pricing in a desktop browser
2. Press Tab repeatedly to move keyboard focus through the page
3. Observe the visual appearance of focus indicators on:
   - The first plan tier's "Select Plan" button (contrast 2.41)
   - The second plan tier's "Select Plan" button (contrast 1.98)
   - The annual billing toggle button (contrast 2.05)
4. Compare the focus indicator visibility against surrounding backgrounds

### Expected Behaviour

Focus indicators should meet AAA Focus Appearance requirements: a visible perimeter of at least 2px around the focused element with a contrast ratio of ≥3:1 against adjacent colors, making them clearly perceivable for users tracking keyboard navigation.

### Actual Behaviour

All four focus stops have visible indicators that fall short of the AAA bar — either insufficient perimeter thickness or inadequate contrast (ranging from 1.98 to 2.41), making them hard to perceive for low-vision users.

### Testing Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Browser | Chrome 126 (assumed based on staging environment) |
| OS | macOS 14 / Windows 11 |
| Screen reader | N/A |
| Testing tool | keyboard-a11y-tester v1.0 |

### Impact

Low-vision users navigating via keyboard may struggle to identify which element currently has focus, particularly when moving between pricing tiers and billing options. This can lead to confusion during the plan selection process and increase cognitive load for users who depend on clear visual focus cues.

### Suggested Fix (optional)

Enhance focus indicators to meet AAA Focus Appearance standards:
- Increase focus ring thickness to at least 2px perimeter area
- Ensure contrast ratio of ≥3:1 between focus indicator and background
- Consider using a high-contrast outline or box-shadow approach that remains visible across all theme variations

```css
/* Example enhancement */
button.select-plan:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #005fcc; /* High-contrast blue */
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
